Record notes

Four methods for testing claims, reasoning, assumptions and framework selection from authorized sources.

Version 0.2.3 includes 4 complete skill procedures. Complete reasoning and framework-selection methods; recipient corpus binding plus eight original synthetic framework examples.

Requirements: Host reasoning tools; Explicit binding file for optional helper.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add reasoning-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 3bd544d8b8245352fb6582ce4056b350d9822c6c. SHA-256: 2f2b5286b9571de1aa92a769f29099a6c709b5c5af16098f6542286b00fbcd33.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
